reason: The free first visit costs me nothing and the daily cleaning log plus the cap on kids is exactly what I check for before letting my toddler touch anything. I'd go once or twice to see if it's actually clean, not just pretty.
objection: Is this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? A cleaning log is only paper until I've seen the place myself, and I'd want to read real reviews first. If it's not spotless in person I'm done.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning log and toy-sanitizing in person on the free visit, plus good reviews from other Salisbury parents.
